faqs.a:
Private sewers connected with district sewers may be acquired under such restrictions
               and subject to such regulations as may be prescribed by the council, but no expense
               shall be incurred by the city in acquiring them, and the city shall have power by
               ordinance to compel the owner of any premises in any sewer district or any subdistrict
               to connect the same with the district or with the subdistrict sewer at his own expense.
(Code 1981, § 27-130; Ord. No. 551, § 71, 5-14-1964)
